Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939)
Thank you for the proof of the [Primer](../books.html#353), I hope to send it with additions in another week or so, as soon as I have finished what I have to do for [Mr Freeman](../persons.html#523)[^1]
I am glad you told me about the printer I wish printers would always mark their proofs visibly

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: CMY was simultaneously working on two books for Macmillan called History of France, one in the Historical Primers series edited by J. R.

Green, and [another](../books.html#99) in the Historical Course for Schools series edited by E. A.

Freeman, who was extremely critical of her work and demanded extensive revisions.
